protocol.primary_endpoint: Original development joint group accuracy at 130000 observations.
protocol.secondary_endpoints: Unconstrained exact answer generation, original/expanded training monitors, earlier-reader loss, byte exposure and native live timing.
protocol.comparison: Both arms start from the same complete 10000-observation checkpoint (32 in smoke mode). The final observation multiset, stage boundaries, update/slot/speech budgets match. Lesson order and consequent stage-replay composition/history differ. Earlier measurement points may have different source byte counts.
protocol.timing: Continuation segments after the common prerequisite checkpoint; includes live learning, replay, speech, logging and checkpoint I/O; excludes setup and assessment.
protocol.limits: Fixed exposure stages are not mastery-based promotion or biological ages. This tests ordered versus shuffled practice of one weighted selection, not uniform sampling from the entire expanded corpus. Five source stages share the replay slots, so prior three-stage results are context rather than a matched control.
